tabs.title: Digital Monitoring Built Around Real-World Needs
tabs.description:
Innvonix developed digital experiences that bring monitoring information, operational workflows, and user accessibility into focus.

Monty PRO serves commercial composting facilities through a web-based platform for temperature monitoring, batch management, compliance tracking, and reporting. Monty Compost provides individual users with a dedicated mobile application for accessing environmental measurements and historical monitoring data.

The engineering approach prioritized usability, structured information management, and application experiences designed around each audience.

featureHeaders.title: Automated Temperature Tracking and Compliance
featureHeaders.description:
Monty PRO is a commercial compost monitoring solution designed to help facilities move away from manual temperature tracking and fragmented records.

The platform combines temperature data from connected monitoring devices with batch records, configurable thresholds, compliance tracking, and reporting tools. Operators can access monitoring information through a browser-based interface, making site data available across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

featureItems.title: Automated Temperature Monitoring
featureItems.description:
Make compost temperature data easier to access and review across active operations.

  • Collect readings from connected monitoring probes
  • Review temperature trends through visual dashboards
  • Compare conditions across piles and batches
  • Access historical monitoring records
  • Identify temperature deviations against configured thresholds

cardHeader.title: Mobile Monitoring for Individual Users
cardHeader.description:
Monty Compost extends compost monitoring access through a dedicated mobile application for Android and iOS.

Designed around individual users, the application provides a more accessible way to view environmental measurements and review historical trends without the operational complexity of commercial management software.

items.title: Environmental Monitoring
items.description: Access available temperature, moisture, and gas measurement information through the mobile interface.
